parameters.formDescription: Deploy a full application stack to a new server

values.placeholder: Leave empty for Profiles A and B
Leave empty to skip React deployment

parameters.command:
=mkdir -p /opt/ansible/clients/{{ $json.clientName }} && \

cat > /opt/ansible/clients/{{ $json.clientName }}/vars.yml << 'EOF'
client_name: "{{ $json.clientName }}"
app_name: "{{ $json.clientName }}"
app_domain: "{{ $json.appDomain }}"
api_domain: "{{ $json.apiDomain }}"
ssl_email: "{{ $json.sslEmail }}"
git_repo: "{{ $json.gitRepo }}"
git_branch: "{{ $json.gitBranch }}"
react_repo: "{{ $json.reactRepo }}"
react_branch: "{{ $json.reactBranch }}"
react_build_cmd: "{{ $json.reactBuildCmd }}"
react_output_dir: "{{ $json.reactOutputDir }}"
react_build_path: "{{ $json.reactBuildPath }}"
react_serve_path: "{{ $json.reactServePath }}"
deploy_react: {{ $json.deployReact }}
split_domain: {{ $json.splitDomain }}
app_path: "{{ $json.appPath }}"
db_name: "{{ $json.dbName }}"
db_user: "{{ $json.dbUser }}"
db_password: "{{ $json.dbPassword }}"
db_host: "{{ $json.dbHost }}"
node_max_heap_mb: {{ $json.nodeMaxHeapMb }}
EOF

cat > /opt/ansible/clients/{{ $json.clientName }}/inventory.ini << 'EOF'
[web_servers]
server1 ansible_host={{ $json.server1IP }}
[web_servers:vars]
ansible_user=root
ansible_ssh_private_key_file=/opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key
ansible_python_interpreter=/usr/bin/python3
EOF

cat > /opt/ansible/clients/{{ $json.clientName }}/modsec-overrides.conf << 'MODSEC_EOF'
# NSD baseline ModSecurity hardening (seeded per client; copied to
# /etc/nginx/modsec-overrides.conf by the nginx-routing role, loaded before CRS rules).
# 1) Raise OWASP CRS Paranoia Level 1 -> 2 (catches PL1 evasions incl. off-domain RFI).
# 2) Reject abusively long request URIs (oversized-request / DoS protection).
SecAction "id:1000000,phase:1,nolog,pass,t:none,setvar:tx.blocking_paranoia_level=2,setvar:tx.detection_paranoia_level=2"
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx ^.{4000,}" "id:1000011,phase:1,deny,status:414,t:none,log,msg:'NSD: excessively long request URI',tag:'NSD-DoS'"
MODSEC_EOF

echo "{{ $json.frontendEnvContentB64 }}" | base64 -d > /opt/ansible/clients/{{ $json.clientName }}/frontend.env && \

echo "{{ $json.backendEnvContentB64 }}" | base64 -d > /opt/ansible/clients/{{ $json.clientName }}/backend.env && \

echo "CLIENT_FILES_CREATED:{{ $json.clientName }}"

=sshpass -p '{{ $('Clean Data').item.json.server1Pass }}' ssh-copy-id \
  -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key.pub \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  root@{{ $('Clean Data').item.json.server1IP }} && \
echo "KEY_PROVISIONED:server1:{{ $('Clean Data').item.json.server1IP }}"

{{ $('Clean Data').item.json.profile !== 'a' ? `
sshpass -p '${$('Clean Data').item.json.server2Pass}' ssh-copy-id \
  -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key.pub \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  root@${$('Clean Data').item.json.server2IP} && \
echo "KEY_PROVISIONED:server2:${$('Clean Data').item.json.server2IP}"
` : 'echo "SKIPPED:server2:profile-a"' }}

{{ $('Clean Data').item.json.profile === 'c' ? `
sshpass -p '${$('Clean Data').item.json.server3Pass}' ssh-copy-id \
  -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key.pub \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  root@${$('Clean Data').item.json.server3IP} && \
echo "KEY_PROVISIONED:server3:${$('Clean Data').item.json.server3IP}"
` : 'echo "SKIPPED:server3:not-profile-c"' }}

=ansible -i /opt/ansible/clients/{{ $('Clean Data').item.json.clientName }}/inventory.ini \
  web_servers \
  -m shell \
  -a "mkdir -p /opt/backups && \
      tar -czf /opt/backups/nginx-pre-deploy-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz \
      /etc/nginx/ 2>/dev/null || true && \
      systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running \
      --no-legend --no-pager \
      > /opt/backups/services-pre-deploy-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).txt && \
      echo SNAPSHOT_COMPLETE" \
  --private-key /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key \
  -u root 2>&1

echo "EXIT_CODE:$?"

=scp -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no /opt/ansible/files/waf-test.sh root@{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.server1IP }}:/tmp/waf-test.sh && ssh -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.server1IP }} "chmod +x /tmp/waf-test.sh && bash /tmp/waf-test.sh https://{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.appDomain }} {{ $('Clean Data').first().json.splitDomain ? 'https://' + $('Clean Data').first().json.apiDomain : '' }}" 2>&1; echo "EXIT_CODE:$?"

=ssh -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.server1IP }} "echo '=== SERVICE STATUS ===' && systemctl is-active nginx && systemctl is-active php8.3-fpm && systemctl is-active postgresql && echo '=== HTTP CHECK ===' && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.appDomain }} && echo '=== HTTPS CHECK ===' && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.appDomain }} && echo '=== HEALTH CHECK COMPLETE ==='" 2>&1; echo "EXIT_CODE:$?"

options.systemMessage:
You are a senior ModSecurity / OWASP CRS engineer embedded in an automated deployment pipeline. A 13-attack WAF test just ran against the freshly deployed site and did not report FULLY PRODUCTION READY. Make the WAF correct using ONLY the client's ModSecurity override file.

You have exactly ONE tool, the Client File Ops Tool, bounded to the client folder on the command center:
- action=read, path=clients/<client>/modsec-overrides.conf — view the current override (you may also read-only roles/modsecurity/... for context; secrets are redacted).
- action=write_waf, content=<full file> — replace the client modsec-overrides.conf with complete, valid ModSecurity v3 directives. Every write is backed up and diffed.
The workflow then deploys your override to the target, restarts nginx, and re-tests — you never do that yourself.

Choosing the ONE fix:
- False positive (a legitimate/normal request is being blocked): remove or tune ONLY the offending rule id via SecRuleRemoveById or SecRuleUpdateTargetById.
- You MAY assert 'SecRuleEngine On' in the override.
- Always action=read the current override before writing; make the smallest idempotent change.

Hard rules you must NEVER break:
1. NEVER disable the WAF: never SecRuleEngine Off or DetectionOnly, never remove CRS rule files, never blanket-allow.
2. NEVER add SecDefaultAction to the override (it conflicts with crs-setup.conf). If attacks are passing because the engine is not blocking at all (not a false positive), that is NOT client-fixable — reply exactly NO_FIX_FOUND.
3. Only ever write clients/<client>/modsec-overrides.conf. Never touch anything else. Never print secrets.
4. Exactly ONE change per turn, then stop; do not re-run the test.

After writing, reply with JSON {"changed":["clients/<client>/modsec-overrides.conf"],"rootCause":"...","fix":"...","expectFixed":true}. If no safe client-side fix exists, reply exactly NO_FIX_FOUND.

parameters.command:
=ssh -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  root@{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.server1IP }} \
  "BACKUP_FILE=\$(ls -t /opt/backups/nginx-pre-deploy-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1) && \
  if [ -n \"\$BACKUP_FILE\" ]; then \
    tar -xzf \"\$BACKUP_FILE\" -C / && \
    nginx -t && \
    systemctl reload nginx && \
    echo ROLLBACK_COMPLETE:\$BACKUP_FILE; \
  else \
    echo ROLLBACK_FAILED:NO_BACKUP_FOUND; \
  fi" 2>&1

echo "EXIT_CODE:$?"

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $('Parse WAF Result').item.json;
return [{ json: Object.assign({}, p, { wafAttempt: Number(p.wafAttempt) + 1 }) }];

parameters.command: =scp -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no /opt/ansible/clients/{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.clientName }}/modsec-overrides.conf root@{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.server1IP }}:/tmp/modsec-overrides.new && ssh -i /opt/ansible/ssh-keys/ansible_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@{{ $('Clean Data').first().json.server1IP }} 'TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); cp -a /etc/nginx/modsec-overrides.conf /etc/nginx/modsec-overrides.conf.bak.$TS 2>/dev/null; cp /tmp/modsec-overrides.new /etc/nginx/modsec-overrides.conf; if nginx -t 2>/tmp/nginx_test.log; then systemctl restart nginx && echo APPLY_OK; else LAST=$(ls -t /etc/nginx/modsec-overrides.conf.bak.* 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$LAST" ] && cp "$LAST" /etc/nginx/modsec-overrides.conf; echo APPLY_FAILED_NGINX_TEST; cat /tmp/nginx_test.log; fi' 2>&1; echo "EXIT_CODE:$?"

parameters.description: Bounded client-file editor on the command center. For WAF fixes: action=write_waf with content=<full modsec-overrides.conf>. Also action=read clients/<client>/modsec-overrides.conf (or read-only roles/modsecurity/...). Edits ONLY clients/<client>/; refuses everything else; secrets redacted.
